The '''51st [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and television for 1993, were held on January 22, 1994, at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills]], [[California]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title='Schindler's List' Breaks the Jinx for Spielberg|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-01-24-ca-14907-story.html|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=24 January 1994}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Complete list of 1994 Golden Globe winners|url=https://variety.com/1994/film/news/complete-list-of-1994-golden-globe-winners-117672/|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Variety|date=23 January 1994}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Spielberg wins best director award for 'Schindler's List'|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=861&dat=19940124&id=QSdSAAAAIBAJ&sjid=3TUNAAAAIBAJ&pg=987,1440939&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=14 January 2018|work=The Victoria Advocate|date=24 January 1994}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 22, 1993.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Frook|first1=John|title=Golden Globe noms announcement set|url=https://variety.com/1993/film/news/golden-globe-noms-announcement-set-116332/|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Variety|date=6 December 1993}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title='Schindler,' 'Piano' Head Globe List|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-12-23-me-4902-story.html|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=23 December 1993}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globe nominations|url=https://variety.com/1993/tv/news/golden-globe-nominations-116901/|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Variety|date=22 December 1993}}</ref>
